title: Demo: prove the two-agent coordination loop
description: End-to-end proof that two agents on separate checkouts coordinate through coordination/main on GitHub: claim arbitration, overlap/conflict rejection, handoff, ready, and release. Deliverable is docs/coordination-demo.md recording the run.

docs/coordination-demo.md written on the task branch and handed off complete
claim file deleted on release and status reflects it on both checkouts
